method.scope: All three numeric cutoffs shift together by -0.1, 0, or +0.1 kg/m3; bin index 2 is the middle-high numeric bin in each scheme.
method.selection_timing: This sensitivity was designed after inspection of the baseline annual series, so it is a challenge, not preregistered confirmation.
method.collocation: centered adjacent-cell mean and upstream T-cell density with the same native velocity and wet-face support

boundary: Changing arbitrary numeric density cutoffs may change bin occupancy and signed horizontal flux without changing any native volume or velocity. This post hoc sensitivity is not a water-mass classification, transformation rate, matched inventory tendency, or budget; vertical/mixing/assimilation and submonthly covariance remain absent.
